en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2028 - Imam (as) was asked about Laylatul Qadr, and Imam (as) said:

"On it, the angels and the scribes descend to the lowest heaven, where they record what will occur during the year, including what will befall the servants. However, there is an affair with Allah (swt), the Almighty and Majestic, that remains subject to His will: He advances from it what He wills, delays from it what He wills, erases, and establishes.
'And with Him is the Mother of the Book' (Surah Ar-Ra'd 13:39)."
